name: lb2-nav
description: The navigator for LongBench v2: the model reads the text with two commands, search (the lines containing some words, with line numbers) and read (a range of lines), one per turn, until it answers or the step budget is spent. A document that fits the context is given whole in the baseline's prompt, with the commands for checking passages; one that does not is navigated from its head. Any document length works.
